reason: The monoclinic cell, Z=2, density/composition, pyroxene framework, and screw-preserving Sc/In ordering class are well supported, and the submitted ordering fits better than the simple alternative partitions or averaged parent. An independently parameterized, chemically restrained P21 whole-profile refinement, with explicit comparison against occupational/symmetry alternatives, could materially improve the coordinates and candidate coverage, so another attempt is warranted.
